critical_code_review_comments: ProfilePendant.jsx cleanly separates TierMedallion (icon-only) from ProfilePendant (medallion+pill wrapper) — good composability. Both no-op when tier is null which correctly hides the pendant for users with no unlocked tier.

Rewards.jsx + Referrals.jsx now use bg-[var(--nb-card)] and tier-color overlays instead of hardcoded dark-brown gradient — theme-adaptive as intended. Computed style confirms bg flips to white in light mode.

Backend progress_pct formula: `min(100, count*100/next_tier.min_referrals)` — reads intuitively for the user (5/10 => 50%). Note: once user unlocks the top tier, `next_tier` is None and progress_pct hard-codes to 100 — correct.
